_comment: Measured against controlplane.tailscale.com, read-only. Recorded because the repository previously documented this endpoint as RSA-PSS-only, which is wrong and had become a roadmap blocker. Re-measure before relying on it: Let's Encrypt can reissue, and the check that consumes this must assert what it observed rather than assume ECDSA forever.

key_exchange._comment: The IPv4 and IPv6 frontends differ. Measured against four fixed IPv4 backends, X25519-only was refused 8/8 while P-256-only succeeded 8/8; over IPv6 X25519-only succeeded 3/3. embedded-tls offers Secp256r1 (P-256), so the IPv4 route works — but a client that offered only X25519 would fail on IPv4 and succeed on IPv6, which is exactly the kind of difference that reads as an intermittent bug.
